title: appointments.appointments.update
description: Edits ONE appointment and writes only what it names (appointments#274): the customer's name, phone and email and the notes are written as sent, a field left out keeps what the appointment has, and a field sent empty (`""`) clears it — so none of them carries a `default`, which the runtime would fill in before the handler could tell «not sent» from «sent empty». Since appointments#271 the professional, the service and the slot are not: when any of them changes, the edit is judged exactly like a move from the agenda (`appointments.appointments.reschedule`) — the professional and the service resolved against the hub's records, the catalogue's name and price, the professional's hours, blocked time, overlap, notice — and a `null` professional or service keeps the one the appointment has.

customer_name.description: Left out = keeps the name the appointment has. It cannot be emptied.

customer_phone.description: Left out = keeps the phone the appointment has; `""` clears it.

customer_email.description: Left out = keeps the email the appointment has; `""` clears it.

service_id.description: The service of the appointment; `null` keeps the one it has. A new one travels WITH `staff_id` and brings its catalogue name and price.

service_name.description: Ignored since appointments#271: the name comes from the catalogue. Still accepted so older callers are not refused.

staff_id.description: The professional of the appointment; `null` keeps the one she has. A new one travels WITH `service_id` and is judged for it.

staff_name.description: Ignored since appointments#271: the name comes from the staff records. Still accepted so older callers are not refused.

end_datetime.description: Optional. The end is the start plus the duration; one that says otherwise is refused (`appointments.invalid_end`).

duration_minutes.description: Optional. When omitted the appointment keeps its length, or takes the new service's.

notes.description: Left out = keeps the notes the appointment has; `""` clears them.

internal_notes.description: Left out = keeps the internal notes the appointment has; `""` clears them.
